{{Quote|I hope this wasn't the droid you were ''looking'' for. Looks like your mission is ''over''.|[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], upon destroying [[J-3PO]]|<ref name="Hunted" />}}
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] launched a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Asuin]], sending [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to retrieve a task force that had uncovered the coordinates of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' strategic [[hypermatter generator]]s. However, the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] destroyed [[J-3PO]], the Republic [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that had been carrying the coordinates.
